text: Audit toàn bộ code backend (thư mục app, Python) và frontend (app/static và app/templates) của dự án manga-translator này. Chia việc cho nhiều agent con chạy song song theo từng vùng code, đọc kỹ code thật rồi tìm lỗi thật: bug logic, lỗ hổng bảo mật, race condition, xử lý lỗi thiếu, code chết, chỗ frontend gọi API không khớp backend. Mỗi phát hiện ghi mức độ, file:dòng, mô tả và cách sửa. Chỉ nêu những gì bạn đã đọc thấy trong code, không đoán. Cuối cùng tổng hợp một báo cáo xếp theo mức độ.

args.message: Audit the FastAPI routers in /tmp/agent-work/project/app/routers/ (account.py, agent.py, ai_mode.py, automation.py, chapters.py, editor.py, export.py, image.py, ocr.py, render.py, render_commit.py, translation.py, visual_qc.py) and app/main.py for REAL defects only, by reading the actual code. Look for: (1) logic bugs (wrong comparisons, off-by-one, incorrect state transitions, resource leaks — unclosed files/locks, missing cleanup), (2) security holes (missing auth/validation, path traversal in filename handling, command injection, unsafe file operations, secrets exposure, missing rate limiting where obvious), (3) error handling gaps (exceptions that leak state, swallowed errors that cause silent corruption, no rollback), (4) race conditions (shared mutable state guarded incorrectly, check-then-act, job state transitions without locks), (5) dead code. Also read app/dependencies.py, app/security.py, app/upload_utils.py, app/page_processing_jobs.py since routers rely on them. For each finding report: file:line, severity (critical/high/medium/low), description of exactly what the code does, and suggested fix. ONLY report issues you verified by reading the code — quote or reference the actual lines. Do not speculate about code you did not read. Keep the report structured and in Vietnamese.

Audit the core pipeline code in /tmp/agent-work/project/app for REAL defects only, by reading the actual code. Scope: app/pipeline.py, app/pipeline_editing.py, app/optimized_pipeline.py, app/page_processing.py, app/page_processing_jobs.py, app/pipeline_editing.py, app/manifest_utils.py, app/mask_store.py, app/image_io.py, app/box_format.py, app/region_policy.py, app/editorial_gate.py, app/render/text_renderer.py, app/render/page_renderer.py, app/inpaint/lama_inpainter.py, app/ocr/service.py, app/ocr/reading_order.py, app/ocr/paddle_v6.py, app/translation/vision.py, app/runtime_responsiveness.py, app/vc_runtime.py, app/model_contracts.py. Look for: (1) logic bugs (wrong math on coordinates/boxes, incorrect slicing, off-by-one, wrong defaults, incorrect conditional branches), (2) race conditions and thread-safety issues (shared model state, global caches mutated without locks, job state transitions), (3) error handling gaps (partial writes/corrupted output, swallowed exceptions that continue with bad data, resource leaks), (4) security issues (unsafe deserialization, path handling, unbounded memory), (5) dead code. For each finding report: file:line, severity (critical/high/medium/low), description of exactly what the code does, and suggested fix. ONLY report issues you verified by reading the code — reference actual lines. Do not speculate. Keep the report structured and in Vietnamese.

Audit the frontend JavaScript in /tmp/agent-work/project/app/static/js/ (all files: api.js, main.js, editor.js, editor-geometry.js, editor-history.js, editor-inspector.js, editor-persistence.js, editor-presets.js, agent.js, ai-mode.js, chapter-ocr.js, page-navigator.js, preview.js, review.js, review-workspace.js, source-language.js, theme.js, toast.js, ui-shell.js, upload.js, icons.js, and review-stitch/*) and app/templates/index.html for REAL defects only, by reading the actual code. Report every mismatch: path, method, or field name that does not match. (2) logic bugs (wrong state updates, stale closures, race conditions on async responses — e.g. out-of-order fetch responses overwriting newer state, missing await, unhandled promise rejections that break UI state), (3) security issues (XSS via innerHTML/DOMParser with unsanitized data, token exposure in URLs/localStorage, missing error handling that leaks), (4) dead code (functions never called, unreachable branches).     51	    if delay < 0:
    52	        raise ValueError("delay must be >= 0")
    53	    src_path, dst_path = Path(src), Path(dst)

    81	        lines[start:stop] = new

    30	def frontmatter(text: str) -> tuple[dict[str, str], str]:
    31	    """The YAML front matter's top-level scalar fields and the body after it."""

    41	        if match and not line.startswith((" ", "\t")):
    42	            if key and block:
    43	                fields[key] = " ".join(block).strip()
    44	            key, value = match.group(1), match.group(2).strip()
    45	            block = []
    46	            if value in ("|", ">", "|-", ">-", ""):
    47	                continue
    48	            fields[key] = value.strip("\"'")
    49	            key = None
    50	        elif key:
    51	            block.append(line.strip())
    52	    if key and block:

    61	    for root in roots:

    92	    _, body = frontmatter(skill.file.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
